boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY Queens College
boards.description: A guide to the essential late-night food stops for CUNY Queens College students, from 24-hour diners to campus-adjacent pizza and halal spots.

cards.title: 24-Hour Bagel Runs
cards.subtitle: Bagel Oasis
cards.notes: Visit this 24/7 institution for hand-rolled bagels and spreads. It is a primary late-night destination for students living in Fresh Meadows or commuting via the LIE.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour bagel shop on the Horace Harding Expressway known for traditional hand-rolled bagels.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel Oasis is open 24 hours, 7 days a week at 183-12 Horace Harding Expressway.
cards.source_title: The 21 Best 24-Hour Restaurants in NYC for Your Round-the-Clock Cravings
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Midnight Coffee and Donuts
cards.subtitle: Dunkin' at 153-67 Horace Harding Expy
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour location near the north edge of campus for a late-night caffeine fix or a quick snack during overnight study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Dunkin' and Baskin-Robbins location situated directly across from the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 15367 Horace Harding Expy in Flushing is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 15367 Horace Harding Expy in Flushing | Coffee & Donuts Near You
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The Campus Halal Cart
cards.subtitle: Shah's Halal at 65-30 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Grab a platter of chicken or lamb over rice at this campus staple. It serves as a reliable evening food source for students leaving late classes.
cards.short_summary: A popular halal food cart and storefront located at the intersection of Kissena Blvd and Horace Harding Expressway.
cards.evidence_claim: Shah's Halal Food has a location at 65-30 Kissena Blvd & Horace Harding Expy, serving the Queens College community.
cards.source_title: Food Trucks & Carts - Shahs Halal Food
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 10:00 PM or later depending on campus activity.

cards.title: Post-Class Pizza Slices
cards.subtitle: Gino's of Kissena
cards.notes: Show your student ID for a discount on slices and rolls. This pizzeria is a frequent stop for commuters heading to the bus stops on Kissena Blvd.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood pizzeria located just outside the Queens College campus gates.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's of Kissena is located at 65-01 Kissena Blvd and offers a 10% discount to students with ID.
cards.source_title: Gino's Pizza – The Best Pizza in Flushing
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 PM Wednesday through Saturday; 9:00 PM other nights.

cards.title: The 24/7 Dorm Snack Run
cards.subtitle: The Summit Apartments Lobby
cards.notes: Access quick meals like ramen or yogurt at any hour. These machines are the primary late-night food source for residents within the campus gates.
cards.short_summary: Vending machines located in the lobby of the on-campus residence hall, providing 24-hour food and drink access.
cards.evidence_claim: Vending machines at The Summit are located off the main lobby and are available 24 hours per day, offering snacks and quick meals like ramen.
cards.source_title: Amenities - Summit Apartments - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for residents; lobby access may be restricted for non-residents late at night.

cards.title: Late-Night Glatt Kosher
cards.subtitle: Pita Hot - Pomonok
cards.notes: Order a shawarma platter or falafel wrap at this Glatt Kosher spot on Main Street. It is a key late-night option for the campus's large Jewish community.
cards.short_summary: A Glatt Kosher Mediterranean restaurant on Main Street frequently visited by Queens College students.
cards.evidence_claim: Pita Hot at 75-43 Main St is open until 11:00 PM on most weeknights.
cards.source_title: Order Pita Hot - Pomonok Delivery Online
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday; closes early on Fridays for Shabbat.

cards.title: The Main Street Chicken Stop
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Fried Chicken
cards.notes: Head to Main Street for fried chicken, gyros, and burgers. This spot is known for staying open well past midnight for the local student population.
cards.short_summary: A classic NYC late-night fried chicken and fast food outlet located on Main Street near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Fried Chicken is a go-to for late night food in the area, with some locations in Flushing open until 3:00 AM or 4:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Kennedy Fried Chicken : r/Flushing
cards.access_notes: Open late daily, often until 3:00 AM.

cards.title: Chicken Finger Cravings
cards.subtitle: Raising Cane's on Main Street
cards.notes: Take the Q25 or Q34 bus down Main Street for a late-night Box Combo. This newer addition to Flushing is a popular destination for student groups.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain specializing in chicken fingers, located in the heart of Flushing.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's at 39-20 Main Street is open until 3:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Flushing, NY, - 39-20 Main Street
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: The Kissena Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: McDonald's at 72-69 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Visit the closest major fast-food chain to the south end of campus. It is a standard late-night stop for students with cars or those walking from the dorms.
cards.short_summary: A standard McDonald's location with a drive-thru, situated just south of the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 7269 Kissena Blvd is a primary late-night food option near campus.
cards.source_title: Best Restaurants Near Me in Queens
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The 24/7 Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: 7-Eleven on Main Street
cards.notes: Stock up on snacks, drinks, or hot food at any hour. This location serves as a reliable fallback when other local eateries have closed for the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located on Main Street, providing essential late-night supplies for students.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven locations in the Queens area are typically open 24/7, providing snacks and hot food.
cards.source_title: Find a Store | 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study hubs and social lounges that Queens College students rely on for daily productivity and relaxation across the Flushing campus.

cards.title: Level 2 Computer Commons
cards.subtitle: Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library
cards.notes: Access desktop PCs and high-volume printing services on the library's second floor. It is a primary hub for students needing tech resources between classes.
cards.short_summary: A tech-heavy study floor in the main library featuring desktop workstations and printing stations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Commons area on level 2 has desktop computers and printing services available for student use.
cards.source_title: The Queens College Library: A Resource for All Students - The Knight News
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; requires a valid QCard for entry to the building.

cards.title: Honors Hall Study Space
cards.subtitle: Honors Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this designated quiet area for solo or group work. It offers a computer lab and ample seating for students seeking a focused environment away from the main library.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, designated study room and computer lab located in Honors Hall Room 5.
cards.evidence_claim: Honors Hall Room 5 is open to all students as a designated study space with plenty of seats and tables.
cards.source_title: Study Space - First Year Experience - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Kiely Hall Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Kiely Hall, Room 131
cards.notes: Visit Room 131 for peer tutoring or to use the technology-enabled study spaces. It includes whiteboards and charging stations for mobile devices.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study hub in Kiely Hall offering tutoring, whiteboards, and device charging.
cards.evidence_claim: The QC Learning Commons in Kiely Hall 131/144 offers collaborative study space, whiteboards, and charging stations.
cards.source_title: Queens College Learning Commons - Tutoring, Study Space - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open during fall and spring semesters; check official site for specific staff office hours.

cards.title: Powdermaker Elevator Lounges
cards.subtitle: Powdermaker Hall
cards.notes: Find seating areas located directly across from the elevators on the first, second, and third floors. These are convenient spots for quick reviews before class.
cards.short_summary: Convenient hallway lounges located near the elevators on multiple floors of Powdermaker Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lounges can be found in Powdermaker Hall, first, second, and third floors, located across from elevators on each floor.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building operating hours.

cards.title: Klapper 5th Floor Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Klapper Hall
cards.notes: Head to the fifth floor to find lounge seating on both sides of the elevators. It is a quieter alternative for students in the arts and humanities wing.
cards.short_summary: A fifth-floor lounge space in Klapper Hall used for quiet study and waiting between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Lounges can be found in Klapper Hall, fifth floor Mezzanine (to the right and left of the elevators).
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours.

cards.title: Science Building Main Lobby
cards.subtitle: Science Building
cards.notes: Use the seating in the first-floor main lobby for studying or joining online courses. This high-traffic area is a central meeting point for STEM students.
cards.short_summary: A large, accessible lounge area located in the main lobby of the Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Lounges can be found in the Science Building, first floor main lobby area.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Available during building hours; often used for Zooming into online courses.

cards.title: Remsen Hall Corridor Lounges
cards.subtitle: Remsen Hall
cards.notes: Locate study seating at the ends of the second and third floor corridors. These spots are often quieter than the main building lobbies.
cards.short_summary: Study lounges situated at the ends of hallways on the upper floors of Remsen Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lounges are at the end of the 2nd and 3rd floor corridors in Remsen Hall.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Accessible during standard building hours.

cards.title: Queens Hall Central Staircase
cards.subtitle: Queens Hall
cards.notes: Find open study space on the second floor to the left of the elevator. This area provides a break from the more crowded central campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: An open study area located off the central staircase on the second floor of Queens Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Hall has an open area to the left of the elevator, off the central staircase on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Building hours are typically 6:30 AM to 8:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Music Library Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Aaron Copland School of Music
cards.notes: Access the largest music collection in the CUNY system. It offers specialized study spaces and practice rooms for students in the music program.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library within the Music Building featuring two levels of resources and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The music library is located on two levels in the Aaron Copland School of Music building.
cards.source_title: About the Library | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Check official library hours; typically closes earlier than the main Rosenthal Library.

cards.title: Student Union Social Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Union
cards.notes: Relax or socialize in the open lounge area. It serves as a central point for student organizations and veterans' support services.
cards.short_summary: A social and relaxation hub for students located within the Student Union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union office provides an open student lounge where all students can socialize and relax.
cards.source_title: Government, Services & Facilities | Queens College Catalog - CUNY
cards.access_notes: The Student Union gate is typically open from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore the best free social and study spots at CUNY Queens College, from art galleries and music performances to quiet library lounges and active recreation spaces.

cards.title: Godwin-Ternbach Museum
cards.subtitle: Klapper Hall, Room 405
cards.notes: View a permanent collection of over 4,000 global art objects. Admission is free for all CUNY students and staff with a valid ID card.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus museum featuring ancient and modern art from around the world.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is open to all CUNY students, faculty and staff with approved entry ID card. Admission is free.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Godwin-Ternbach Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Thursday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM during the academic semester.

cards.title: Rosenthal Library Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: 65-30 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Access six floors of study carrels and group work areas. Entry requires a valid QCard or CUNY ID for the turnstiles.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering multiple floors of free, quiet study environments for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Library access is limited to currently enrolled CUNY students, faculty and staff with valid CUNY IDs. Entry is free via turnstiles.
cards.source_title: Visiting | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the semester; check library website for specific floor hours and holiday closures.

cards.title: Open Gym Recreation
cards.subtitle: FitzGerald Gymnasium, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Participate in informal basketball, volleyball, or badminton during scheduled open hours. Bring your own towel for entry.
cards.short_summary: Free indoor athletic recreation for students including basketball and fitness equipment use.
cards.evidence_claim: Open gym procedures for Fall & Spring include basketball courts available Monday-Thursday 12:15 PM - 2:45 PM for students with ID.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Fitness - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open gym hours are typically mid-day; a valid QC ID and proper workout attire are mandatory.

cards.title: Queens College Art Center
cards.subtitle: Rosenthal Library, 6th Floor
cards.notes: Visit this unique rotunda gallery for 3-5 free exhibitions annually featuring emerging and established artists.
cards.short_summary: A public gallery space on the top floor of the library hosting rotating contemporary art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Center offers 3-5 free and public exhibitions per year in its unique rotunda layout.
cards.source_title: Queens College Art Center | School of Arts - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Located on the 6th floor of the Rosenthal Library; accessible during library hours.

cards.title: Student Union Lounges
cards.subtitle: Student Union Building
cards.notes: Relax in various open lounge areas throughout the building. The Union serves as the primary social hub for campus clubs.
cards.short_summary: Free social and relaxation spaces for students to gather between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union contains major social, cultural, and recreational facilities and is the hub of campus life.
cards.source_title: Student Union - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:00 AM to 10:30 PM, and Friday-Sunday 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Free Music Performances
cards.subtitle: Music Building
cards.notes: Attend hundreds of annual concerts, including orchestral and jazz performances, most of which are free for students.
cards.short_summary: A wide variety of free musical performances hosted by the Aaron Copland School of Music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aaron Copland School of Music hosts hundreds of concerts each year, most of which are free to Queens College students.
cards.source_title: Opportunities for Non-Music Majors | Aaron Copland School of Music
cards.access_notes: Check the performance calendar on the ACSM homepage for specific event dates and times.

cards.title: The Campus Quad
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Enjoy the open green space for outdoor studying or socializing. This area hosts major free events like Welcome Day and Fall Fest.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering space for the Queens College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is the site for large-scale events like Welcome Day and concerts sponsored by the Student Association.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space during campus operating hours.

cards.title: Summit Courtyard
cards.subtitle: 64-15 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Relax in the lighted outdoor seating areas and courtyards located within the residential complex.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor seating and social areas located at the campus residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Summit Apartments feature amenities including outdoor seating areas and lighted courtyards.
cards.source_title: Floor Plans & Pricing - Summit Apartments - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Common areas are primarily for residents, but courtyards are visible and accessible to the campus community.

cards.title: Learning Commons Study Space
cards.subtitle: Kiely Hall, Room 131
cards.notes: Utilize free peer tutoring and open study spaces designed to support student success across various subjects.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student support space offering free tutoring and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: QCLC offers study spaces and workshops free for all Queens College students.
cards.source_title: Queens College Learning Commons - Tutoring, Study Space - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic hours; check the QCLC website for specific tutoring schedules.

cards.title: Newman Center Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Union, Room 208
cards.notes: Visit the open student lounge for socializing and relaxation. The center is open to all students regardless of faith.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming multi-faith social space located within the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The office provides an open student lounge where all students can socialize and relax.
cards.source_title: Religion & Spirituality - Student Development and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.entity_name: Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library Study Carrels
cards.title: Quiet Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Levels 4 and 5 of Rosenthal Library
cards.notes: Utilize these personal carrels for focused, silent work. They are available on a first-come, first-served basis for students requiring a distraction-free environment.
cards.short_summary: Individual quiet study carrels located on the upper floors of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosenthal Library has personal carrels for quiet study use located on levels 4 and 5, available on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Maps & Spaces | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; requires a valid QCard for entry through turnstiles.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Kiely Hall, Rooms 131 and 144
cards.notes: Access technology-enabled spaces featuring iMacs, Windows PCs, and whiteboards. This area supports both collaborative group work and quiet individual study.
cards.short_summary: A tech-equipped study and tutoring center located in Kiely Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The QC Learning Commons in Kiely Hall 131/144 offers collaborative and quiet study space with iMacs, Windows PCs, and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Queens College Learning Commons - Tutoring, Study Space - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday-Thursday 9am-5pm during active semesters.

cards.title: Music Building Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Music Building, Lower Level
cards.notes: Request access at the Music Library Circulation Desk for rooms 125a or 125c. These spaces are dedicated to group study for students with valid IDs.
cards.short_summary: Designated group study rooms located within the Aaron Copland School of Music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library has two rooms on the Lower Level (125a and 125c) available for group study on a first-come, first-serve basis.
cards.source_title: Music Library Study Room Policies & Procedures - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Available during Music Library hours; must present valid QC ID at the desk.

cards.title: Elevator-Adjacent Lounges
cards.subtitle: Powdermaker Hall, Floors 1-3
cards.notes: Find seating in the open lounge areas located directly across from the elevators on the first three floors. Ideal for quick study sessions between classes.
cards.short_summary: Convenient open-access study lounges on multiple floors of Powdermaker Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus lounges can be found in Powdermaker Hall on the first, second, and third floors, located across from elevators on each floor.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during general building hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: QCAP Study & Meeting Room
cards.subtitle: Powdermaker Hall, Room 251
cards.notes: Reserve this space for private Zoom meetings or group study sessions. The room often provides snacks and refreshments for students.
cards.short_summary: A reservable community space in Powdermaker Hall for academic needs.
cards.evidence_claim: The QCAP Space in Powdermaker Hall 251 can be reserved for private Zoom meetings or study space with friends.
cards.source_title: QCAP Community Space | Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9:30 AM - 3 PM; reservations recommended.

cards.title: Main Lobby Study Area
cards.subtitle: Science Building, First Floor
cards.notes: Use the seating in the main lobby area for studying or attending online courses. This central spot is easily accessible from the campus quad.
cards.short_summary: A public study lounge located in the main entrance of the Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: A campus lounge is located in the Science Building, first floor main lobby area, for studying or zooming into online courses.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; free for all students.

cards.title: First Year Experience Study Room
cards.subtitle: Honors Hall, Room 5
cards.notes: Drop by this designated space for solo or group study. It offers a quiet environment with ample tables and chairs for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, designated study room open to all students in Honors Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Honors Hall Room 5 is open to all students as a designated study space with plenty of seats and tables.
cards.source_title: Study Space - First Year Experience - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during office hours.

cards.title: The Dome Desks
cards.subtitle: Freestanding structure near Powdermaker Hall
cards.notes: Work at long tables equipped with swiveling, adjustable seating and power outlets. This unique architectural space is often used for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A unique freestanding structure featuring long desks and power outlets for laptops.
cards.evidence_claim: Campbell Dome seats 88 at rows of long tables offering swiveling, adjustable seating and outlets for laptops.
cards.source_title: Classrooms and Lecture Halls | Queens College, CUNY
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled events; typically open for student use when not in session.

cards.title: Corridor Study Nooks
cards.subtitle: Remsen Hall, Floors 1-3
cards.notes: Find quiet spots at the ends of the second and third-floor corridors or across from labs 151, 251, and 351. These areas are tucked away from main traffic.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study lounges located at the ends of hallways in Remsen Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lounges in Remsen Hall are located on the first, second, and third floors across from labs and at the end of the 2nd and 3rd floor corridors.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Queens Hall Open Study
cards.subtitle: Queens Hall, Floors 1 and 2
cards.notes: Study in the open area to the left of the elevator on the second floor or in front of Room 135. These spots offer a change of pace from the main campus.
cards.short_summary: Open-access study areas located in Queens Hall, across from the library annex.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Hall has study lounges on the first floor (in front of Room 135) and second floor (open area to the left of the elevator).
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; located slightly off the main campus quad.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the corridors and blocks surrounding the CUNY Queens College campus, from the bustling shops of Kissena Boulevard to the transit hubs of Flushing.

cards.title: The Classic Pizza Corner
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 65th Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a slice at this neighborhood staple located directly across from the campus main gate, a frequent stop for students between classes.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing pizzeria located at the intersection of Kissena Boulevard and 65th Avenue, serving the Queens College community.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's of Kissena is located at 65-01 Kissena Blvd, directly opposite the Queens College campus, and is a popular local dining spot for students.
cards.source_title: Gino's Pizza – The Best Pizza in Flushing
cards.access_notes: Open daily for walk-in orders and dining.

cards.title: The South Campus Slice
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 71st Avenue
cards.notes: Walk south from the Student Union to find this local alternative for pizza and Italian entrees, often less crowded than spots closer to the main gate.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned pizzeria and restaurant located south of the main campus on Kissena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Valentino's Pizzeria and Restaurant is located at 71-47 Kissena Blvd, approximately a 10-15 minute walk south of the Queens College Student Union.
cards.source_title: Valentino's Pizzeria and Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Accessible via a short walk or the Q25/Q34 bus lines.

cards.title: Boba and Sushi Break
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 60th Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this modern spot for bubble tea and sushi rolls, a popular hangout for students from both Queens College and nearby Townsend Harris.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary Japanese restaurant and tea bar located north of the campus on Kissena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Qiu Sushi & Tea Bar is located at 60-05 Kissena Boulevard and is noted by student media as a popular spot for bubble tea and snacks near campus.
cards.source_title: Can't We All Just Get Oolong? Harrisites review Kissena Boulevard's Qiu Sushi, Ramen, & Tea Bar - The Classic
cards.access_notes: Indoor seating available; located near the Q17 and Q88 bus stops.

cards.title: Cantonese Comfort Food
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 60th Street
cards.notes: Stop by for roast meats over rice and other Cantonese specialties at this local eatery situated just north of the Long Island Expressway.
cards.short_summary: A Cantonese restaurant offering traditional dishes and lunch specials near the northern edge of the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: MJ USA (東旺飯店) is located at 60-10 Kissena Blvd and is recognized for its Cantonese cuisine and roast meats.
cards.source_title: M & J USA Restaurant in Queens / Menus & Photos - WhereYouEat.com
cards.access_notes: Open daily for takeout and dine-in.

cards.title: The Athletics Corridor
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Reeves Avenue
cards.notes: Access the college's athletic fields and gymnasium through this gate, located on the western edge of campus near the Main Street commercial strip.
cards.short_summary: The western entrance to the Queens College campus, providing access to the Fitzgerald Gymnasium and athletic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitzgerald Gymnasium is located on Reeves Avenue between Main Street and Kissena Boulevard, with a campus gate servicing the area.
cards.source_title: Directions - Queens College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian access available during campus operating hours.

cards.title: Off-Campus Study Space
cards.subtitle: Main Street & 72nd Avenue
cards.notes: Find a quiet place to work at this public library branch, located a short walk from the southern end of the campus in Kew Gardens Hills.
cards.short_summary: A branch of the Queens Public Library serving the Kew Gardens Hills neighborhood near Queens College.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kew Gardens Hills branch of the Queens Public Library is located at 72-33 Vleigh Place, near the intersection of Main Street and 72nd Avenue.
cards.source_title: Kew Gardens Hills - Queens Public Library
cards.access_notes: Free public access; check library website for current operating hours.

cards.title: Neighborhood Green Space
cards.subtitle: Vleigh Place & 77th Avenue
cards.notes: Relax at this local park located just south of the campus, offering basketball courts and open space for students living in Kew Gardens Hills.
cards.short_summary: A public park and playground located in the Kew Gardens Hills neighborhood south of Queens College.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Valley Playground is located at Vleigh Place and 77th Avenue in Kew Gardens Hills, providing recreational facilities for the community.
cards.source_title: Queens Valley Playground - NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: The Transit Connection
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Roosevelt Avenue
cards.notes: Take the college shuttle or a city bus to this major transit hub for access to the 7 train and the diverse food scene of downtown Flushing.
cards.short_summary: The central intersection of downtown Flushing, serving as a primary transit link for Queens College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Flushing-Main Street station is a major transit hub connected to Queens College via the Q25 and Q17 bus lines and the college's own shuttle service.
cards.source_title: Directions - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: 24-hour public transit access; shuttle service hours vary by semester.

cards.title: The Southern Gateway
cards.subtitle: Union Turnpike & Vleigh Place
cards.notes: Explore the shops and restaurants along this major thoroughfare, which connects the campus area to the Kew Gardens-Union Turnpike subway station.
cards.short_summary: A commercial corridor south of the campus featuring various dining and retail options for the local community.
cards.evidence_claim: Union Turnpike is a major southern border of the Kew Gardens Hills neighborhood and a key transit route for students accessing the E and F subway lines.
cards.source_title: Kew Gardens Hills, Queens - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Q46 bus line from the campus area.

cards.title: The Eastern Edge
cards.subtitle: Parsons Boulevard & 75th Avenue
cards.notes: Discover local delis and convenience stores along this stretch, located just east of the campus and accessible via the Q25 bus.
cards.short_summary: A residential and commercial area on the eastern side of the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Parsons Boulevard is a major north-south road in Queens that runs east of the Queens College campus and features local businesses serving the area.
cards.source_title: PARSONS BOULEVARD, Flushing-Jamaica - Forgotten New York
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Q25 bus line which stops near the campus.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and recurring celebrations that define student life at CUNY Queens College, from late-night finals fuel to symbolic marches through the campus gates.

cards.title: Marching Through the Main Gate
cards.subtitle: A symbolic entry for new Knights
cards.notes: Join the traditional ceremony where incoming students march through the main gate to symbolize the opening of future opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic march through the campus main gate for new students during Welcome Day.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Day includes a traditional ceremony where new students march through the main gate symbolizing endless opportunities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the fall Welcome Day event for new students.

cards.title: The MidKnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Late-night fuel for finals week
cards.notes: Head to the Student Union during finals week for a late-night meal served to students as a collective study break.
cards.short_summary: A late-night breakfast event held during finals week to support students.
cards.evidence_claim: The MidKnight Breakfast is a traditional event sponsored by the Student Association and administration during finals week.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held late at night (typically 8:00 PM or later) in the Student Union during finals week.

cards.title: Spring Fest on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The annual end-of-year celebration
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with live music, food, and activities on the central Quadrangle.
cards.short_summary: An annual large-scale festival held on the Quad every spring semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Fest is listed as a large-scale traditional program hosted by the College Union Programming Board.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Annual event held on the Quad during the spring semester.

cards.title: Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Kicking off the autumn semester
cards.notes: Join the campus community for an outdoor festival featuring student organizations and entertainment to start the fall term.
cards.short_summary: A traditional autumn festival held on campus to welcome students back.
cards.evidence_claim: Fall Fest is a recurring traditional event organized by the Office of Student Development and Leadership.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the fall semester, typically on the Quad.

cards.title: The Monday Mile
cards.subtitle: Walking for wellness with campus leadership
cards.notes: Participate in a community walk led by the College President to promote wellness and kick off Diversity Week.
cards.short_summary: A recurring community walk led by the President to promote campus wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monday Mile is a collaboration with the President's office to kick off Diversity Week.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Typically held annually to start Diversity Week.

cards.title: Homecoming Step Show
cards.subtitle: A celebration of Greek life and culture
cards.notes: Watch the National Pan-Hellenic Council's annual high-energy performance featuring rhythmic stepping and cultural celebration.
cards.short_summary: An annual step show performance hosted by the National Pan-Hellenic Council during Homecoming.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Pan-Hellenic hosts an annual Homecoming Step Show for students and alumni.
cards.source_title: The National Pan-Hellenic hosts their Annual Homecoming Step Show
cards.access_notes: Held annually during Homecoming; tickets may be required for some venues.

cards.title: Snowflake Social
cards.subtitle: Winter community gathering
cards.notes: Gather with fellow students for a seasonal social event featuring winter-themed activities and refreshments.
cards.short_summary: A traditional winter social event for the Queens College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Snowflake Social is listed as a traditional program provided by the Office of Student Development and Leadership.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the winter season, typically in the Student Union.

cards.title: Harvestfest
cards.subtitle: Autumnal campus celebration
cards.notes: Enjoy fall-themed activities and community building during this annual harvest celebration.
cards.short_summary: An annual autumn-themed event for students and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvestfest is identified as a large-scale traditional event at Queens College.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the fall semester.

cards.title: Club Day on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The heartbeat of campus involvement
cards.notes: Explore dozens of student organizations and cultural clubs during this massive recruitment fair on the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A major semesterly event where student clubs showcase their activities and recruit members.
cards.evidence_claim: Club Day is a prominent event where over 90 clubs and organizations showcase school spirit.
cards.source_title: Friends, food, and fun: QC club day - The Knight News
cards.access_notes: Held during the 'Free Hour' on the Quad, typically early in the fall and spring semesters.

cards.title: Commencement on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The final walk as a student
cards.notes: Join the massive outdoor graduation ceremony held on the central Quad, a tradition dating back to the college's early years.
cards.short_summary: The official annual graduation ceremony held outdoors on the campus Quadrangle.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens College's main commencement ceremony takes place on the Quadrangle.
cards.source_title: Commencement - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Held annually in late May for graduating students and their guests.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at CUNY Queens College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Move-In Morning
cards.subtitle: 64-80 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Start your weekend by checking into your new home. New students typically move in during late August; remember to bring a photo ID to collect your keys and orientation pack.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus residential hall for Queens College students.
cards.evidence_claim: New students move in on specific dates in late August (e.g., August 26 for Fall 2026) and must bring a photo ID to the Housing Office.
cards.source_title: Move In - Summit Apartments - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Access restricted to residents and authorized guests; check-in requires a valid photo ID.

cards.title: The Ceremonial March
cards.subtitle: Kissena Blvd and 65th Ave
cards.notes: Join the tradition of marching through the main gate during Welcome Day. It symbolizes the opening of doors and opportunities for your academic journey as a new Knight.
cards.short_summary: The iconic entrance where new students participate in a traditional welcome ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: New students participate in a traditional ceremony to march through the main gate during Welcome Day.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students during the annual Welcome Day event.

cards.title: Presidential Welcome
cards.subtitle: Near the Main Entrance
cards.notes: Gather at this tree-lined lawn to be formally greeted by the college President and administrators. It is a key meeting point for orientation leaders and new peers.
cards.short_summary: A large outdoor plaza used for formal greetings and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: College administrators formally greet students at Alumni Plaza during Welcome Day activities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space on campus.

cards.title: Lunch at the Union
cards.subtitle: 152-45 Melbourne Ave
cards.notes: Head to the Student Union for a midday meal. It serves as a hub for student clubs and is the temporary home for many student services during campus renovations.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student life, dining, and club activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union provides dining services and is a primary location for Welcome Day lunch and icebreakers.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8 am-7 pm; summer hours may vary.

cards.title: Afternoon Concert
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Lawn
cards.notes: Relax on the 130,000-square-foot green space for a free concert. Past performers include mainstream artists like Waka Flocka Flame and Jay Sean.
cards.short_summary: The largest outdoor space on campus, hosting concerts and major events.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Day includes a FREE concert with mainstream artists on the Quad, open to all QC students.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; concerts are typically scheduled during orientation and spring/fall fests.

cards.title: Library Exploration
cards.subtitle: Level 3 Entrance
cards.notes: Visit the library to activate your QCard and explore six levels of study space. Check out the Computer Commons on Level 2 for printing services.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering extensive research resources and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has six levels of study areas and requires an active QCard for entry.
cards.source_title: Services | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Requires active QCard for entry; check website for current semester hours.

cards.title: Art Break
cards.subtitle: 405 Klapper Hall
cards.notes: Spend an hour viewing a collection of over 3,500 objects ranging from antiquity to modern prints by artists like Andy Warhol.
cards.short_summary: A teaching museum on campus with a diverse permanent art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum's exhibitions and events are open to Queens College students and the public.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Godwin-Ternbach Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10 am-4 pm; follows the academic calendar.

cards.title: Evening Workout
cards.subtitle: Second Floor Fitness Center
cards.notes: Get active at the fitness center. Remember to bring your QC ID and a towel, as entry is strictly enforced for students and staff.
cards.short_summary: The campus athletic facility featuring a fitness center and basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Access to the Fitness Center is for current QC students with a valid ID and a mandatory towel.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Fitness - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Fall/Spring hours typically 12:00 PM-5:00 PM; sneakers and towel required.

cards.title: Evening Performance
cards.subtitle: 153-49 Reeves Avenue
cards.notes: Catch a show at the largest arts complex in Queens. Students often receive a 50% discount on select ticketed events with a valid ID.
cards.short_summary: A major performing arts complex hosting music, dance, and theater.
cards.evidence_claim: Current Queens College students receive a 50% discount on select events at the Kupferberg Center.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Kupferberg Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Box office hours vary; student discounts apply to select 'KCA Presents' events.

cards.title: Sunday Morning Stroll
cards.subtitle: Fresh Meadows Lane
cards.notes: Walk just off-campus to this historic park. It features a lake, nature trails, and a velodrome, offering a quiet escape from the city bustle.
cards.short_summary: A large public park adjacent to the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Kissena Park is a nearby destination for students, offering outdoor recreation and nature trails.
cards.source_title: QC Neighborhood - Student Life - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.
